WITH refund_eur AS (
  SELECT pr.tenant_id,
         pr.amount / er.rate AS eur_amount,
         CASE WHEN po.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND pr.processed_at > po.paid_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_late
  FROM payment_refunds pr
  JOIN exchange_rates er
    ON er.base_code = 'EUR'
   AND er.quote_code = pr.currency_code
   AND er.as_of = CAST(pr.processed_at AS date)
  LEFT JOIN payout_items pi ON pi.payment_id = pr.payment_id
  LEFT JOIN payouts po ON po.id = pi.payout_id
  WHERE pr.status = 'succeeded'
    AND pr.processed_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND pr.processed_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
tenant_agg AS (
  SELECT tenant_id,
         SUM(eur_amount) AS total_refunds_2025_eur,
         SUM(CASE WHEN is_late = 1 THEN eur_amount ELSE 0 END) AS late_refunds_2025_eur
  FROM refund_eur
  GROUP BY tenant_id
),
company_agg AS (
  SELECT SUM(eur_amount) AS total_eur,
         SUM(CASE WHEN is_late = 1 THEN eur_amount ELSE 0 END) AS late_eur
  FROM refund_eur
)
SELECT t.name AS tenant_name,
       ta.total_refunds_2025_eur,
       ta.late_refunds_2025_eur,
       ROUND(ta.late_refunds_2025_eur / NULLIF(ta.total_refunds_2025_eur, 0) * 100, 1) AS pct_of_own_refunds_late,
       ROUND(ca.late_eur / NULLIF(ca.total_eur, 0) * 100, 1) AS company_avg_pct_late_2025
FROM tenant_agg ta
JOIN tenants t ON t.id = ta.tenant_id
CROSS JOIN company_agg ca
ORDER BY ta.total_refunds_2025_eur DESC, t.name ASC
LIMIT 15
note: Late is defined as payment_refunds.processed_at strictly after the settling payout's paid_at; refunds whose payment never appears in payout_items are excluded from the late bucket (per spec) but still count in total_refunds. company_avg_pct_late_2025 is computed company-wide (all tenants, not just the top 15) and repeated on every row.
